beats.stateChange: The thesis resolves into three visible fragments on a shared system rail.
beats.cameraOrLayerMotion: Headline and fragments enter on separate depth layers.
beats.pptRisk: Do not replace the fragments with a static before-and-after card.

beats.stateChange: The fragments travel along one rail and collapse into a shared destination.
beats.cameraOrLayerMotion: The rail draws outward before the fragments move into it.
beats.pptRisk: Do not make the mechanism a numbered list or a sequence of cards.

beats.stateChange: One highlighted destination holds the final resolved system state.
beats.cameraOrLayerMotion: The destination glow anchors the final layer while the system settles.
beats.pptRisk: Do not turn the close into a separate CTA card.
